Getting started

Install VIKI Agent from a source checkout, connect a model, and start a chat. The visual guide gives an illustrated overview; these manuals have the full steps.

On this page
  1. 01What you need

  3. 03VIKI Agent's own window

01What you need

Check these requirements before you install.

  • Operating system
    Windows 11, macOS on Apple silicon, or desktop Linux on x86_64 or aarch64 with glibc 2.28 or later. macOS also needs git, which Xcode Command Line Tools provide (xcode-select --install). Linux also needs X11 or Wayland, xdg-open, git, and a Secret Service available through secret-tool (package libsecret-tools). The .deb package declares libsecret-tools, git and zenity | kdialog, the folder picker's dialog, as dependencies.
  • Vault folder
    keep a vault in a folder that is not cloud-synced. On Windows, VIKI Agent refuses the OneDrive folders that the OneDrive, OneDriveConsumer and OneDriveCommercial environment variables name. On macOS, it refuses ~/Library/Mobile Documents (iCloud Drive) and ~/Library/CloudStorage (the cloud providers' folders) as cloud-synced, and the rest of ~/Library as a system folder. On Linux, it refuses no folder for being cloud-synced.
  • Python
    Python 3.14 or newer and uv.
  • Node.js
    Node.js 24 with npm to build the interface.
  • Browser window
    Microsoft Edge on Windows by default. On macOS, discovery checks Edge, Chrome and Chromium. On Linux, install a non-confined Edge, Chrome or Chromium executable; snap and Flatpak launchers are skipped. See Configuration to select an explicit executable.
  • VIKI Agent's own window
    needs no installed browser.
  • Claude Code
    a source checkout runs the copy of Claude Code that uv sync installs with the Claude Agent SDK. The compiled app and installer builds run your own Claude Code, installed with Anthropic's installer. On Windows: irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex. On macOS or Linux: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash. See Anthropic's setup guide.

The app uses the existing Claude Code CLI without installing or modifying it. Connect a model through either route:

  • Claude Code sign-in
    your Claude plan, or an API key or cloud provider you set up in Claude Code. A chat that is not signed in offers Sign in for your Claude plan on Windows, macOS and Linux.
  • Your own model
    add a cloud API or local model server in Settings → Providers. Custom connections need a tool-calling model and support Chat Completions, Responses API and Anthropic Messages.

02Install and start

Clone VIKI Agent's GitHub repository (the visual guide links to it), then run these commands from its root on Windows, macOS, or Linux:

uv sync
npm --prefix frontend ci
npm --prefix frontend run build
uv run viki-agent

First launch

The first launch opens the setup guide on Welcome to VIKI. It lists the steps with their state and an action for each:

  1. Install Claude Code (needed). VIKI Agent runs every chat through Claude Code and doesn't install it. Anthropic's setup guide and the install commands are in Settings → Providers. Restart VIKI Agent after installing.
  2. Sign in to Claude, or connect a model (needed). Sign in opens Claude Code's own sign-in, and VIKI Agent checks it when a chat starts. Or save a model connection and select Use for new chats.
  3. Create or open a vault (needed for notes, Bots, Kanban and the persona). Choose Create a vault, Open a folder or Set up later. Open a folder registers an existing folder read-only: you can browse its notes and chat about them, and the app's own note saving stays off there. Without a vault, chats still run in a shared temporary folder. A vault you create or open starts being used after the next restart.

The guide also lists optional features: Bots and Kanban, model connections, code folders, routines, voice and messaging. To open the guide again, use Help → Setup guide.

A new vault can start from either of these:

  • Start with VIKI (recommended)
    adds folders, note templates, empty memory, Kanban, agents and skills.
  • Blank folder
    holds only a welcome note, and .viki/vault.json too if you tick Write portable metadata.

Send a message in a new conversation to start chatting.

  • Claude Code sign-in
    complete sign-in in Claude Code if it is missing.
  • Your own model
    save its endpoint, model ID and optional key in Settings → Providers, then select Use for new chats. See Using your own model.

Stop and update

Closing the last app window gives running chats up to 300 seconds to finish. Waiting permission requests are denied while no window is open.

To update:

  1. Stop running work first.
  2. Wait for the app process to exit before you update the checkout or run uv sync or other upgrades.
    • Windows
      confirm in Task Manager that the VIKI Agent process you launched has exited.
    • macOS
      quit the browser if it remains open.
    • Linux
      wait until the command you started VIKI Agent with, such as uv run viki-agent, returns to the prompt.
  3. Back up VIKI Agent's app data folder: an older version refuses to open app data that a newer version has updated.
  4. Update the checkout, for example with git pull.
  5. Repeat the install and start commands.

03VIKI Agent's own window

VIKI Agent can also open in its own window, on any desktop, with no Edge, Chrome or Chromium installed. After the install steps above (uv sync and the built frontend are still needed), run:

npm --prefix desktop ci
npm --prefix desktop start
  • First start
    downloads Electron from GitHub and checks it against the SHA-256 sums its npm package lists.
  • Closing the last window
    follows the usual rules above.
  • Quitting the app
    stops running chats at once.

04Notes and voice

Note saving, the note actions, and keeping a chat image in the vault are supported on Windows, macOS and Linux. This needs a supported drive: NTFS on Windows, APFS on macOS, or ext4, XFS, Btrfs or tmpfs on Linux. On another drive, such as a network drive, the vault stays read-only.

Voice

Voice is optional. To inspect available offline speech models and backends, run:

uv run python scripts/voice_setup.py --list
  • Install
    run uv run python scripts/voice_setup.py to install the recommended model and backend.
  • Check
    then run uv run python scripts/voice_setup.py --check to check existing installation folders for missing, resized or irregular files.

Setup downloads the selected files; voice processing runs locally. GPU voice setup may require a compatible NVIDIA driver and the Microsoft Visual C++ runtime on Windows.

05Optional local wheel

After building the frontend, create a local wheel with:

uv run python scripts/build_product.py

The wheel includes the built interface, app icon and bundled third-party license notices. The frontend configuration skips local .env files and custom client environment variables; app settings come from the local server.

Important

Keep personal settings, credentials and vault copies out of product resource folders.

The build scripts check resources and filenames:

  • Extra resources
    rejected outside the bundled interface, welcome note and starter set.
  • Private filenames
    wheel members and compiled backends are checked for private filenames such as .env, database files, private keys, logs and source maps.
  • Refusals
    a refusal names the file without showing its contents.
  • Runtime files
    the bundled certifi CA certificates and contained framework links are checked separately so those runtime files can be included.

06Optional compiled app

After building the frontend, build a standalone folder app with Nuitka. The script refuses an editable install and prints the command to use instead, so run exactly:

UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=<folder outside the repo> uv run --no-editable --no-dev --group build python scripts/compile.py

In PowerShell, set the variable first: $env:UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT = "<folder outside the repo>", then run the same uv run command.

This needs:

  • Windows
    MSVC (Visual Studio 2022 or later with the C++ tools).
  • macOS
    Xcode.
  • Linux
    gcc and patchelf.

The result is the folder dist/compiled/viki-agent.dist/. Start viki-agent (viki-agent.exe on Windows) in that folder. It runs without Python, uv or Node, and uses the Claude Code you install.

Dictation setup (scripts/voice_setup.py above) needs a checkout. The compiled app's own folder is not one, and VIKI Agent refuses it as a vault or code folder.

07Optional installers

After building the compiled app above (scripts/compile.py, which also writes dist/compiled/viki-agent-licences.json), build installers for Windows, macOS or Linux with electron-builder. npm run dist needs npm ci in both frontend/ (the install steps above) and desktop/.

Build on the OS and architecture you intend to install on. The installer command refuses cross-platform and cross-architecture targets; Linux builds use the host's x64 or arm64 architecture:

npm --prefix desktop ci
npm --prefix desktop run dist

The result lands in dist/desktop/:

  • the installers
  • SHA256SUMS-<os>.txt
  • three software-bill-of-materials files: sbom-python.cdx.json, sbom-frontend.cdx.json and sbom-desktop.cdx.json
  • THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES-<os>.txt

These builds are unsigned. Known issues lists what Windows and macOS ask when you open one.

Check an installer against its checksums with sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS-linux.txt or shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS-macos.txt. On Windows, use PowerShell's Get-FileHash.
